verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jira has saved searches ([jira-comm-12]) built on its query language JQL ([jira-comm-17]), and the docs mention multiple views of work ([jira-docs-11]). That covers the 'save a filtered view' half of the story, though a user calls creating a useful saved search very painful. Nothing in the pack shows sharing a saved view through a link. Missing for 10: first-party docs on saved filters, evidence of sharing via link or permissions, and hands-on corroboration of a smooth save-and-share flow.
